purpose: Evaluate non-executable numerical sufficiency of future closed-position evidence against locked baseline without reusing the 47 seen historical trades.
arm_definition: Both arms must report observations over an identical predeclared forward evaluation calendar window and the same Bybit BTCUSDT Spot reference; specific trade entries need not coincide.
entry_exit_constraint: All positions must have distinct identifier, post-cutoff entry and later closed exit, no overlap within each long-only arm, no open or unsettled positions included.
pnl_constraint: Conservative-cost net PnL in USDT with same 500-USDT illustrative initial capital; candidate strictly positive and not below baseline net result.
low_drawdown_constraint: Externally reconstructed, independently authenticated intratrade Low-based modeled max drawdown per arm; numerical candidate <= 0.8 * baseline, requiring baseline >0; this gate does NOT compute or verify a fill or Low timeline.
conflict_constraints: Reject candidates selected after seeing forward outcome, missing venue/cost/source verification, inconsistent dates, unstable risk rules, or reporting only wins while excluding eligible loses.
no_asserted_edge: Passing numeric checks is NECESSARY, NOT SUFFICIENT: must independently verify raw data provenance, cost/fills, open exposure and precommitments, and then obtain separate user permission before Paper promotion.
tests: SYNTHETIC only until authentic >12 prospective fully closed positions exist
